stories.title: Affected by layoffs? Don’t miss this $75 deal for your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Expo+ Pass
stories.simple_summary: TechCrunch is offering discounted passes to a tech conference for people who lost their jobs. It's a promotional offer.
stories.why_it_matters: This is just an advertisement for a conference — nothing you need to act on unless you want to attend industry events.

stories.title: Opinion | Who should be held liable when AI causes harm?
stories.simple_summary: An opinion piece asks who should be responsible if an AI system does something wrong or harmful.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an important discussion for the future, but right now there are no clear answers — it's still being debated by lawmakers and companies.

stories.title: Apple says it’s tightening macOS ‘Full Disk Access’ controls due to new risks from AI agents
stories.simple_summary: Apple is making it harder for AI programs to access all your personal files, messages, and browsing history without permission because these AI programs are becoming more powerful.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use a Mac computer, this means Apple is trying to protect your privacy better — you'll likely see more permission requests from AI tools.

stories.title: Call it AI, call it Super Intelligence, only 2% of consumers are buying it
stories.simple_summary: Most consumers (98%) are not actually using or interested in new AI products, even though tech companies are promoting them heavily.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're not using AI yet, you're in the majority — there's no rush, and you shouldn't feel pressured by all the hype around it.

stories.title: It’s not AI anymore, it’s ‘super intelligence’ (according to the White House)
stories.simple_summary: The Trump administration officially renamed AI to 'super intelligence' and got major tech CEOs to sign a safety pledge.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about how the government is trying to manage AI development — it's unlikely to directly affect how you use technology.

stories.title: Breaking up (with Elon Musk) is hard to do
stories.simple_summary: A personal breakup announcement by someone connected to Elon Musk became public on social media.
stories.why_it_matters: This is celebrity gossip and has nothing to do with AI or technology that affects you.

stories.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Blackstone’s Jas Khaira on building the next generation of AI giants
stories.simple_summary: TechCrunch is promoting a conference speaker who will discuss building new AI companies.
stories.why_it_matters: This is just an advertisement for a tech conference — nothing you need to act on unless you want to attend.

stories.title: Circuit Breaker Labs hopes to make AI safer for your kids (and you)
stories.simple_summary: A company called Circuit Breaker Labs is working to make AI safer and less harmful to people, especially children.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have kids, this is a good sign that people are thinking about protecting young people from negative effects of AI.

stories.title: Trump expected to tap DNI Jay Clayton for AI czar
stories.simple_summary: The Trump administration is considering appointing someone to oversee AI policy for the U.S. government.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly relevant to investors and people tracking government policy — it won't directly change how you use AI in your daily life right now.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV is not a fan of AI-generated art
stories.simple_summary: The Pope said that AI-generated art is not real art because it lacks human creativity and comes from machine calculations rather than human emotion.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an opinion about the value of AI art — if you care about traditional art and human creativity, this reflects a growing concern some people share.

stories.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Clay’s Kareem Amin on the rise of the GTM engineer
stories.simple_summary: TechCrunch is promoting a tech conference speaker who will discuss a new job role in tech companies.
stories.why_it_matters: This is just an advertisement for a tech conference — nothing you need to act on unless you want to attend.

stories.title: Trump wants to stamp out the term ‘artificial intelligence’. Why?
stories.simple_summary: President Trump wants to stop using the term 'artificial intelligence' and use 'super intelligence' instead instead.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a political rebrand with no real impact on how the technology works or affects you — mostly a messaging change for government and media.
